Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/recap-v0.21.0-v0.23.1-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ, the last few weeks — new lanes, new ears

Songs split on the computer now separate the backing vocals from the lead: mute the harmonies and sing over just the lead, or the other way round. The lyrics engine was replaced end to end — it hears far more of what you actually sang, and stops inventing phrases into the silence.

Lock your phone mid-song and the band plays on: the Lock Screen shows it and controls it. Songs open in a moment instead of decoding first, on the computer and the phone alike.

And SingZ made it onto the App Store — iPhone doesn't need TestFlight anymore.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/singz-sing-with-the-band/id6806430347

Russian

🎤 SingZ за последние недели — новые дорожки, новые уши

Песни, разделённые на компьютере, теперь отделяют бэк-вокал от солиста: выключите подпевки и пойте поверх одного солиста — или наоборот. Движок распознавания слов заменён полностью — он гораздо точнее слышит то, что вы спели, и больше не выдумывает фразы в тишине.

Заблокируйте телефон посреди песни — группа продолжит играть: экран блокировки показывает песню и управляет ею. Песни открываются мгновенно, а не распаковываются целиком — на компьютере и на телефоне.

И SingZ добрался до App Store — для iPhone больше не нужен TestFlight.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/singz-sing-with-the-band/id6806430347

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/recap-v0.21.0-v0.23.1-poster.png
